original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

current_process.text: I normally use last month's sales to work out what we need for the week.

customer_context_unchanged.original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

refined_task: At 2025-11-30 estimate recorded fulfilled positive product units for the coming week and lead-time-plus-review coverage. Net coverage plus supplied safety stock against usable stock and dated incoming units; apply minimum orders and multiples; flag shortages before a new order can arrive. Produce all 336 supported products at stores, including zero orders, and a configurable local non-LLM routine.
manual_work_replaced: subtract usable stock and eligible incoming deliveries
apply supplied safety stock, minimums and multiples
prepare order list and timing exceptions
incumbent_unknowns: stock netting, safety and rounding steps

candidate_rationale_before_scoring.baseline: Previous complete calendar month sales divided by its days, multiplied by seven; transparent analytical interpretation, not exact incumbent replication.
candidate_rationale_before_scoring.recent13: Per-pair 13-week mean; sparsity in 17406 rows across 336 pairs makes one-month rates unstable.
candidate_rationale_before_scoring.seasonal_pool: Longer-run pair rates adjusted by pooled calendar-month seasonality; higher November counts recur across years, but local seasonality cannot be assumed stable.
candidate_rationale_before_scoring.ridge: One regularized pooled linear regression with product/store/month effects and strictly lagged demand summaries; shares information across sparse pairs, bounded fixed complexity, CPU-only sklearn/scipy dependencies.

source_evidence.sales: ../released/input-4.csv: 17406 rows, 42 exact duplicates, 28 products, 12 stores; all calendar dates represented globally; 14 historical weeks lack one store's activity.
source_evidence.operations: ../released/input-1.csv through input-3.csv: 336 rules and stock rows, 126 dated incoming lines; operational provenance columns say synthetic and are retained internally, assumed operating facts for this authorized demo.

outcome_limits: Recorded units are a proxy for demand; no historical stockout exposure or cost function.
Cannot establish availability, savings or superiority to unspecified incumbent rules.
October-November is development evidence; December is reserved and untouched.
Independent performance-success gate remains open: no externally declared meaningful threshold or untouched evaluation is supplied.
routine_scope: No LLM/API calls; configurable file paths, date, output. No scheduling installation. Measure preparation, fit, prediction and complete process separately from AI-assisted build.
